articles.title: Asian Para Games: Kokila assures India of judo medal, sets up gold-medal clash
articles.summary: Kokila has triumphed by defeating China's Yi Liu in the para-judo semifinals and is now set to vie for gold against Kyrgyzstan's Aibike Ulanbek Kyzy. Meanwhile, Kapil Parmar is striving for a bronze in the men’s J1 -70kg after a tough semifinal defeat.

articles.title: Species Fund Beats Habitat Target: Evaluation finds 4,800ha restored; 51,000 people engaged

articles.title: HPSC HCS final result 2026 declared for 102 posts; marks and service allocation list released: Check direct link to download here
articles.summary: The Haryana Public Service Commission has announced the HPSC HCS Final Result 2026 for 102 vacancies across the Executive Branch and Other Allied Services. Released on October 17, the result includes candidates’ roll number-wise marks and the service allocation list.

articles.title: APPSC Group 2 Notification 2026: 686 vacancies announced, applications open November 10
articles.summary: APPSC Group 2 Notification 2026: The Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC) has announced 686 provisional vacancies under Group 2 Recruitment 2026 through Notification No. 37/2026, released on October 13, 2026.

articles.title: Coal India MT Result 2026: Check expected release date, vacancies and selection process
articles.summary: Coal India Limited is expected to announce the CIL Management Trainee CBT Result 2026 by October 20 for 660 vacancies. The examination was conducted on August 24, with approximately 1.27 lakh candidates reportedly appearing.

articles.title: Kylie debuts USD 50 million look; Timothee cheers her on - PICS
articles.summary: Kylie Jenner showcased the most expensive Fantasy Bra at the Victoria’s Secret Fashion Show held in Los Angeles. Created in partnership with Jacob & Co., the bra features over 4,400 diamonds and has a value of USD 50 million.

articles.title: Mamitha Baiju thanks Girish AD for trusting her
articles.summary: During the joyous celebration of 'Bethlehem Kudumba Unit's success, Mamitha Baiju shared her deep gratitude to filmmaker Girish AD for his steadfast belief in her potential. Recalling Girish's faith before 'Super Sharanya' hit theaters, she acknowledged the dedication of the cast and crew in achieving this milestone.

articles.title: Tiger Shroff firing: Ranvir, Rahul Dholakia slam attack
articles.summary: Three unidentified attackers fired at Tiger Shroff’s car near Pushpa Park, Juhu, on October 18, injuring his driver Firdous and an autorickshaw driver. Shroff was unharmed.

articles.title: Prahaar Box Office: film earns Rs 9 crore in 3 days
articles.summary: Rajkummar Rao’s Prahaar: The Ujjwal Nikam Story opened slowly on October 16 with Rs 2.35 crore net, rising to Rs 3.15 crore and Rs 3.50 crore over the weekend, totalling Rs 9 crore. It trails Yami Gautam’s Nayyi Navelli, which crossed Rs 10 crore.
